description: The YangOpen voices. tier "free" (default): sixteen free voices — two Vietnamese (Southern accent), American and British English, Mandarin, Japanese, Korean, Thai, French and Spanish. tier "plus": the paid voices, about 2,600 — 182 Vietnamese (Northern, Central and Southern), English, Spanish, Mandarin, French, Japanese and Korean; search them by language, gender and words in the name or style. Returns the id to pass to text_to_speech (free) or text_to_speech_plus (plus).

language.description: Optional language: vi, en, en-US, en-GB, zh, ja, ko, th, fr or es.

limit.description: How many to return, up to 50.

query.description: Optional words to match in the name or style, e.g. "Bắc", "tin tức", "Hoài My".

name: list_voices
title: List or search the voices
